description: Buffer placement: the same in-place streaming pass (x.mul_, 49.6 MB FP32) over buffers allocated different ways (randn then clone, reversed order, eight in a row, whole 2 MiB pages, slices of one allocation, a block reused from the cache), each buffer's time with its address, to find what makes one of two same-size buffers 18% slower (round 4b).
